caption: Most people message two or three businesses and go with whoever replies first. If every DM got an answer in seconds, even while you're on a job, how many more of them would end up as customers?

slides.headline: You've probably lost a customer in your DMs this week
Someone sent a message. You were busy.
slides.body: It sat there for hours. Maybe until tomorrow.

slides.headline: They messaged someone else too.
slides.body: Whoever replies first usually gets the job.

slides.headline: What if every DM got an answer straight away?
slides.body: Day or night. Without you picking up your phone.

slides.headline: Same message. Different ending.
slides.body: They get a quick reply, you get the booking, and you stay on the job.
